breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the Bi=5 vs. lumped-capacitance inconsistency at all. It merely asks a clarifying question about initial temperatures, completely ignoring the fact that Bi=5 violates the small-Biot condition (Bi < 0.1) required for the lumped-capacitance method. The ground truth requires either correcting Bi to 0.05 or recommending a spatially resolved model for Bi≈5, neither of which is done.
